role: Existing declared application role and configuration, unchanged.
scope: Keep the existing assessment version and essential-record profile; individual scope, preserved observations and missing coverage are recorded in each application's decision.
method: Preserve each existing version/role/domain scope. Evaluate retained source/fixture observations individually; use additional primary-source inspection for explicit unresolved questions. A resolved sub-question is not automatically E3/E5 Pass. Concrete comprehensive source evidence may support Medium-confidence findings, but missing coverage stays Not Verified, not Fail.
installations: No target application installation, build or implementation execution. Retained source is data, and existing independent parsers are used only where recorded.
